resolutions.issue: Initial snapshots were serialized with a trailing newline, creating false source-change fingerprints.
resolutions.resolution: Canonical snapshot text is normalized before hashing.

resolutions.issue: The Bundestag Lobbyregister renders a retrieval timestamp that changes on every fetch.
resolutions.resolution: Known volatile retrieval timestamps are normalized before hashing.

resolutions.issue: A mutable current Lobbyregister URL had been used for a historical FY2024 claim.
resolutions.resolution: FY2024 and FY2025 now have separate temporal claims and source mappings.

resolutions.issue: Several PFG/Tönnies pages temporarily returned a tiny bot/challenge response and an early Watchtower version treated it as substantive content.
resolutions.resolution: Last valid snapshots were restored. Watchtower v0.9 classifies severe content collapse as fetch_suspect, preserves the previous snapshot and does not flag dependent claims. The clean control run then reported 14/14 sources unchanged, 0 changed, 0 suspect, 0 failed and no claims needing review.
